subject: Intermittent proxy session spike affecting August invoice
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina@fastcart.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:14:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected billing spike — Aug 9 proxy sessions

Hi Markus,

We're seeing a ~3x token/ session jump on our August 9 invoice compared to the usual baseline for our account (FastCart). I attached a small sample of sessions (fastcart_session_sample.csv) and a screenshot of the invoice line. Could you confirm whether this aligns with Redwood's counting for the window 2026-08-09 00:00 — 2026-08-09 04:00 UTC?

Quick context: we rolled a proxy rewrite on Aug 9 at ~01:15 UTC to improve keepalive behavior. Our infra team suspects the proxy may have inadvertently produced repeated request headers that look like session boundaries.

Questions:
- Can you export the raw session/ request log for that window?
- If there is double-counting/duplication, what evidence do you need to consider a retroactive credit?
- Any ETA on initial triage?

Attaching: fastcart_session_sample.csv (10 rows)

Thanks,
Lina
Lina Torres
Ops Lead, FastCart
ops@fastcart.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@fastcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 17:30:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing spike — Aug 9 proxy sessions

Hi Lina — thanks for the heads up and the sample. We can definitely take a look.

I'll get Ben (billing) to pull the usage export for that UTC window and do a token/session diff. Kimberly I've cc'd for VAT/tax implications if we need to issue a retro credit.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ben will provide a coarse reconciliation within 24 hours with any immediate signs of duplication.
2) If duplication is suspected, we'll request your full usage export for the same window (JSONL or CSV) and any proxy config notes.
3) We'll produce a provisional credit calculation and confirm VAT treatment before issuing anything.

Can you share the full export (usage_export_2026-08-09.jsonl is ideal) and any proxy config diff around the 01:15 UTC rollout?

I will also flag this internally as high-priority since it impacts invoicing/collection.

Thanks — Mark
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0134

From: Lina Torres <lina@fastcart.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fastcart.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:10:45 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing spike — Aug 9 proxy sessions

Thanks Mark — attached the full export as requested.

Attachment: usage_export_2026-08-09.jsonl (excerpt pasted below)

-- excerpt --
{"ts":"2026-08-09T00:58:12Z", "session_id":"s-9a1b", "request_id":"r-5470", "tokens_in": 32, "tokens_out": 180}
{"ts":"2026-08-09T00:58:12Z", "session_id":"s-9a1b", "request_id":"r-5470", "tokens_in": 32, "tokens_out": 180}
{"ts":"2026-08-09T01:02:03Z", "session_id":"s-9a1b", "request_id":"r-5478", "tokens_in": 28, "tokens_out": 120}
-- end excerpt --

Notes from our infra team: after the rewrite the proxy started sending both the original client IP and an internal proxy hop in X-Forwarded-For which may have created a new session key in our backend. We suspect identical request_ids appearing twice is the immediate problem (see excerpt above).

Let me know if you need any further logs (proxy access logs) — we can fetch them but will take the infra team ~2 hours.

Lina

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@fastcart.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing spike — Aug 9 proxy sessions

Hi all — I pulled the usage for FastCart for the UTC window 2026-08-09 00:00 — 06:00 and ran a dedupe/aggregation pass. Initial findings:

Summary:
- We see ~11.6k tokens attributed twice (duplicate request_id entries) between 00:50–01:10 UTC.
- Duplication lines up with the proxy rollout you described. The duplicate rows have identical request_id and token counts.
- No other windows show the same pattern.

Preliminary action:
- I generated a draft credit calc (prelim_credit_calc.csv) which applies a token unit credit for the duplicated tokens. The provisional amount before VAT is $1,067.40.
- If FastCart is VAT-registered in the EU/UK we will need to handle reverse-charge vs. credit memo; Kimberly can advise on VAT treatment.

Evidence attached: prelim_credit_calc.csv (breakdown by request_id), sample query outputs, and a short note on methodology. Our dedupe methodology: group by request_id + session_id + timestamp, collapse exact duplicates, then re-sum tokens. We flagged rows where request_id repeated within <= 5s as likely duplicate writes.

Next steps:
1) Lina: can you confirm you gave us the full proxy access logs (we need to reconcile hop headers).
2) Markus/Marissa: if everyone agrees, we'll issue a provisional credit memo for $1,067.40 (pre-VAT) while we await any additional evidence.
3) Kimberly: please advise VAT handling.

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Lead — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@fastcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing spike — Aug 9 proxy sessions

Thanks Ben — that analysis looks reasonable to me.

Marking this as agreed for a provisional credit while we complete reconciliation. Marissa — can you please coordinate issuance of the provisional credit memo for $1,067.40 (pre-VAT) to FastCart and include a short note: "provisional credit issued pending final reconciliation of duplicate request_id events; credit will be adjusted if additional evidence changes the duplicated token count."

Kimberly — please confirm VAT treatment on this provisional credit (FastCart is US-headquartered, but they have an EU entity listed on the HubSpot record). If VAT is not applicable, we can proceed without tax reclaim steps. If VAT is applicable, advise wording/requirements for the credit memo.

Lina — if you can drop the proxy access log link into the Drive folder (see related links) that will speed final reconciliation.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
